C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a contract every project inherits

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, another project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Warm-up v2
phases.goal: Proposal 20's thirteen decisions built, and both PhotoVault projects reheated onto them.
phases.exit: Every item done with its evidence; both PhotoVault cards read ready on the new tools.

items.title: Project declaration: .common-rules.json (D9)
items.what: A shared loader for .common-rules.json: read_order, safety_rules (file#heading), gates.quick and gates.merge, plan_check, plan_page. .common-rules-test keeps working as gates.merge. bin/land's test_cmd and bin/warmup read it; migrate writes the pointer's read order from it.
items.done: A project declaring its own read order, safety heading and two gates gets a card and a land run that use them; one without the file behaves exactly as today.

items.title: Ledger contract v2 (D2, D4, D5, D6, D7, D8)
items.what: ledger.py learns: model_routing (and a check that a row's model matches its class unless it carries a reason); owner on blocked rows and decision asks; switches; requests; evidence and verify when the ledger declares an evidence rule and a verification ladder; gates, quality_floors, receipts; readiness computed; the merged flag. Every addition optional, so the engine's and the app's ledgers still validate.
items.done: The engine's 71 and the app's 70 ledgers validate unchanged; each new rule has a red test and a named problem.

items.title: Card v2
items.what: bin/warmup prints readiness and merged-awaiting-evidence, only the sponsor-owned items on the yours line, switches that are off, open requests both ways, the project's routing, and prohibitions from the declared safety rules.
items.done: Card tests cover each line; the app's and engine's cards read ready.

items.title: Tracker page v2
items.what: render draws readiness, gates and floors, requests, owners and merged flags.
items.done: Render tests cover each section; the engine's and app's pages render.

items.title: sync honours switches.issues (D5)
items.what: tracker sync exits 0 with a sentence naming who switched issues off, and when.
items.done: A ledger with issues off makes no gh call.

items.title: Agent tag hook (D3)
items.what: hooks/pretooluse-agent reads the Agent prompt's first line and warns, with the ledger row's tag, when [ruflo · tier · model] ID is missing. It warns, never refuses, and never fails the session.
items.done: Tagged prompt: silent. Untagged prompt naming a ledger id: a warning with that row's tag.

items.title: bin/ruflo-item (D11)
items.what: start | done | note | recall around an item: pre-task and memory store; done runs the declared merge gate before post-task; recall lists keys before semantic search; the daemon is stopped on every exit.
items.done: Driven by a fake ruflo on PATH: the call order is exact, the gate runs before done, and the daemon is stopped even on failure.

items.title: derecord v2 (D12, D13)
items.what: The pre-commit hook regenerates and stages the page and checkpoint when a ledger is staged, alongside the conflict-marker guard. It ignores Ruflo runtime state only and installs the V-05 hook.
items.done: A staged ledger commits with its page and checkpoint; Ruflo runtime files are ignored while config stays tracked; derecord stays idempotent.

items.title: Templates: parallel high tier, reviewer, verify level (D10)
items.what: lead-prompt.md: parallel C3 on disjoint files, each with a report-only reviewer of at most the same tier, two rounds; the lead merges, reconciles and decides. brief.md gains a verify level. OPERATING-RULES.md is corrected to branch from origin/main.
items.done: Template tests pin the new sections and the removal of both old lines.

items.title: Publish (D1)
items.what: Artifacts publish only through a session's Artifact tool, which a hook cannot call. So render records the digest last published; the card says 'page changed since last publish'; the lead prompt and /warmup republish when it does.
items.done: A changed ledger shows 'changed since last publish' until the publish is recorded.

items.title: Reheat the PhotoVault engine and app, then measure
items.what: Reheat both sessions now on the current standard; after the build, message each as its pieces land and reheat again; record each card's delta.
items.done: Both cards read ready on proposal 20's tools, and each session's reply is logged.

log.evidence: first reheat sent to both PhotoVault sessions (engine queued, app delivered); a second follows the build

asks.quote: reheat the photovault app and engine
